recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Revisit only if a later final terminology decision such as FHIR-55063 changes where the example medication class CodeSystem or ValueSet should live.
issue_request: FHIR-50605 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request for R6 to add DetectedIssue.medicationClass as an optional 0..* CodeableConcept representing the medication class responsible for a detected issue, with comment examples for duplicate therapy class alerts and allergy class alerts.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3864, merged as 31c3058e643ebd3eb5598a427ec64c0c482e9f38, included implementation commit 137b3650abab5916cd74dc32adcacbfaba7bfd41 adding the medicationClass element plus example medication class CodeSystem and ValueSet. The element, cardinality, type, definition, and binding were already present, but the comment said "duplicate therapy or an alergy alert," which misspelled allergy and broadened the approved duplicate-therapy-class example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists detectedissue=DetectedIssue and assigns detectedissue to CDS, confirming current build scope. CDS 2025-06-25 minutes record approval of the proposed FHIR-50605 resolution by 18-0-0. Targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. FHIR-55063 later mentions DetectedIssue terminology migration but remains Triaged and does not finally require moving the experimental medicationClass example terminology.
reconciliation: Updated only source/detectedissue/structuredefinition-DetectedIssue.xml so the DetectedIssue.medicationClass comment matches the voted Jira text: duplicate therapy class alert or allergy class alert, with both medications belonging to the medication class.
source_changes: source/detectedissue/structuredefinition-DetectedIssue.xml: changed the DetectedIssue.medicationClass comment from the misspelled/broader duplicate therapy or alergy alert wording to the approved duplicate therapy class alert or allergy class alert wording.

related_jiras.note: Later Triaged DetectedIssue terminology migration proposal mentions the medicationClass example terminology but is not final and does not supersede this comment fix.
